about_short_description.short_description: Oasis Holding Company was incorporated in 2008 as Kuwaiti Shareholding Holding Company.

product.name: Oil and Gas
product.description: Oasis Holding Company is an official agent of Dodsal EPC Company, involved in construction and completion of oil gathering centers and oil well water treatment and injection plants in Kuwait.

product.name: Petroleum Dynamics Oil and Gas (PetoDyn)
product.description: A subsidiary specializing in supplying products and services for the oil and gas industry in Kuwait and other GCC countries.

product.name: Cement Industrial
product.description: OASIS Holding Company owns Gulf Nations For Construction Materials Company (GNCMC), which produces Ordinary Portland Cement and Sulfate Resistant Cement with a production capacity of 2.3 million tons per year.

product.name: Steel Industrial
product.description: OASIS Holding Company holds a 75% share in Gulf Steel Company, which has a license for producing approximately 50 thousand tons of rebar per year.

product.name: Investment
product.description: OASIS Holding Company acquires stocks in Kuwaiti or foreign companies, lends money to companies in which it holds stocks, and invests financial surpluses in financial portfolios managed by specialized entities.
